facts.fact: The ITU framework states AGETIC, a government agency, administers a government data centre with its own specialised cybersecurity team, running its security and a real-time-replicated disaster-recovery site; the document gives no date, so the 2022 publication year is used.

The ITU framework states AGETIC, an agency under the communications and digital ministry, provides hosting services (IaaS, SaaS, backup) to the public administration from its data centre; no date is given, so the 2022 publication year is used.
